misconceptions.description: Choosing a metric that cannot confirm or disconfirm the plan's stated hypothesis
misconceptions.trigger: learner pairs a findability or learning hypothesis with a metric that measures a different construct
misconceptions.feedback: Check that the metric can actually test the hypothesis. Re-pair each claim with a metric that can disconfirm it.

misconceptions.description: Assembling a plan whose sample or tasks do not serve the stated hypothesis
misconceptions.trigger: learner's sample, tasks, and hypothesis target different users or test different things
misconceptions.feedback: Trace each part back to the goal. Align the sample to the population and the tasks to the behavior the hypothesis predicts.

misconceptions.description: Accepting a complete-looking plan without auditing whether its parts cohere
misconceptions.trigger: learner submits a generated or polished plan without checking internal alignment
misconceptions.feedback: Run the coherence audit: hypothesis, sample, tasks, metrics, and decision rule must all trace to the same goal.

misconceptions.description: Writing a decision rule that does not connect to the plan's own metrics or thresholds
misconceptions.trigger: learner's decision rule relies on impressions instead of the metrics the plan collects
misconceptions.feedback: Tie the decision rule to a metric and threshold the study gathers so the evidence can actually drive the decision.
